name: Front-Face Webcam Projection
aliases: Webcam stream projection on volumetric display
definition: A method to project a 2D webcam video feed onto the front face of an 8x8x8 volumetric LED cube by averaging pixel colors in grid squares.
summary: Front-Face Webcam Projection maps a 2D video feed to an 8x8 voxel grid by averaging pixel colors, restricting output to a single plane and ignoring depth information.
